artists.name: Keel G
artists.bio: Jakeel Blankenship, known as Keel G, is a Plain Dealing, Louisiana artist, motivator, and creative visionary. His music blends Southern hip-hop, real-life storytelling, motivation, and a self-made mindset built around purpose, growth, and family legacy.
artists.role: Artist • Founder, Badhabits Entertainment • Co-Founder, Top Deck Music Group
artists.story: Keel G has been around music since childhood and began moving independently as a young teenager alongside family. His story is rooted in Plain Dealing, Louisiana, persistence without handouts, self-belief, and building something that can outlive him. His music turns real life into motivation: from the bottom to the top, from the mud to motion.
artists.mission: Create your own reality, follow your purpose, become your best self, and leave a legacy that proves what you imagine can become real.
highlights: Co-Founder of Top Deck Music Group LLC
Co-Founder of The Gas Up Brand

artists.name: All Ace's
artists.bio: Adrion Blankenship, known as All Ace's, brings R&B, motivational rap, Southern roots, and an original perspective to Top Deck. A founder of Top Deck Music Group, his vision extends beyond music into creating opportunities, businesses, and community impact.

artists.name: D-Money
artists.bio: Desmond Davidson, known as D-Money, is a Southern hip-hop artist with roots in Soso and Laurel, Mississippi and a home in Louisiana. His sound mixes motivation, storytelling, R&B influence, hustle, and real-life Southern perspective.

artists.name: YFR Rab
artists.bio: YFR Rab is a Montgomery, Alabama artist and producer whose connection to music goes back to childhood. With close to 20 years of experience, his sound moves across rap, hip-hop, R&B, blues, and dance/bounce.
artists.story: YFR Rab has had a love for music since childhood and has been creating music for close to two decades. He and Keel G linked up in college and have remained close ever since. Rab also spent time serving in the military. Today, he is part of the Top Deck family as both an artist and one of the team’s producers.
artists.mission: Bring his range as an artist and producer to the Top Deck family while continuing to create across the sounds that shaped him.
